<p style="line-height:1.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;"><font size="1" face="Times New Roman">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 20.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(15)</font></b><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160; </font>Divestitures</p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">On May&nbsp;31, 2006, the
Company sold an undivided 50 percent interest in each and all of its Gulf of
Mexico oil and gas leasehold interests and related pipelines and equipment to
an affiliate of Mitsui&nbsp;&amp; Co., Ltd., for approximately $448.8 million,
after purchase price adjustments. The sale resulted in a pre-tax gain of $302.7
million. This gain, along with $2 million of pre-tax gains on sales of other
properties, has been reflected in the caption &#147;Gain (loss) on sale of
properties&#148; in the Company&#146;s results of operations.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 20.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">(16)</font></b><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160; </font>Asset
Retirement Obligations</p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Company accounts for future abandonment costs
pursuant to SFAS 143, which requires that the fair value of a liability for an
asset retirement obligation be recorded in the period in which it is incurred
and the corresponding cost capitalized by increasing the carrying amount of the
related long-lived asset. The liability is accreted to its present value each
period, and the capitalized cost is depreciated over the useful life of the
related asset. If the liability is settled for an amount other than the
recorded amount, a gain or loss is recognized.</font></p>

 <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 24.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">POGO <font style="text-transform:uppercase;">PRODUCING COMPANY&nbsp;&amp; SUBSIDIARIES<br> </font>UNAUDITED SUPPLEMENTARY FINANCIAL AND RESERVES DATA<a name="UnauditedSupplementaryFinancialAn_134024"></a></font></b></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:normal;">Oil and Gas Producing Activities</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The results of operations from oil and gas producing
activities (expressed in millions) exclude non-oil and gas revenues, corporate
general and administrative expenses, other non oil and gas producing expenses,
interest charges, interest income and interest capitalized. Income tax
(expense) or benefit was determined by applying the statutory rates to pre-tax
operating results with adjustments for permanent differences. Except as
indicated, the &#147;Total&#148; amounts reflect only those activities related to the
Company&#146;s continuing operations.</font></p>

 <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 24.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">POGO PRODUCING COMPANY&nbsp;&amp; SUBSIDIARIES<br> UNAUDITED SUPPLEMENTARY FINANCIAL AND RESERVES DATA&#151;(Continued)</font></b></p>


<p style="margin:6.0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:27.0pt;text-justify:inter-ideograph;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The following
information regarding estimates of the Company&#146;s proved oil and gas reserves,
which are located onshore in the United States and Canada and offshore in
United States waters of the Gulf of Mexico for continuing operations and were
located offshore in the Kingdom of Thailand and in Hungary for discontinued
operations, is based on reports prepared by Ryder Scott Company, L.P. (&#147;Ryder
Scott&#148;) and reports prepared by the Company and reviewed by Ryder Scott, for
certain of its domestic properties acquired from Latigo, Ryder Scott
Company&#151;Canada (&#147;Ryder Scott Canada&#148;), for all of its Canadian properties, and
Miller and Lents, Ltd. (&#147;Miller and Lents&#148;), for certain onshore Gulf Coast and
Rocky Mountain properties. The definitions and assumptions that serve as the
basis for the discussions under the caption &#147;Item 1, Business&#151;Exploration and
Production Data&#151;Reserves&#148; should be referred to in connection with the
following information. &#160;Only reserves
data related to the Company&#146;s continuing operations is presented under the
Total amounts.</font></p>

<br clear="all" style="page-break-before:always;">
<div>
 <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:16.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 4.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">POGO PRODUCING COMPANY&nbsp;&amp; SUBSIDIARIES <a name="PogoProducingCompanySubsidiaries_101634"></a></font></b></p> <p style="font-weight:bold;line-height:normal;margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-align:center;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">STANDARDIZED MEASURE OF DISCOUNTED FUTURE <br> NET CASH FLOWS RELATED TO PROVED OIL AND GAS RESERVES&#151;Unaudited</font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The standardized
measure of discounted future net cash flows from the production of proved
reserves (expressed in millions) is developed as follows: </font></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 40.0pt;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">1.</font><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>Estimates are made
of quantities of proved reserves and the future periods in which they are
expected to be produced based on year-end economic conditions. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 40.0pt;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">2.</font><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>The estimated
future gross revenues from proved reserves are priced on the basis of year-end
market prices, except in those instances where fixed and determinable natural
gas price escalations are covered by contracts. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 40.0pt;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">3.</font><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>The future gross
revenue streams are reduced by estimated future costs to develop and to produce
the proved reserves, as well as certain abandonment costs based on year-end
cost estimates, and the estimated effect of future income taxes. These cost
estimates are subject to some uncertainty. </p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 40.0pt;text-indent:-20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">4.</font><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font>The cash flows are
discounted at 10% per annum.</p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The
standardized measure of discounted future net cash flows does not purport to
present the fair value of the Company&#146;s oil and gas reserves. An estimate of
fair value would also take into account, among other things, the recovery of
reserves in excess of proved reserves, anticipated future changes in prices and
costs, a discount factor more representative of the time value of money and the
risks inherent in reserve estimates.</font></p>

individual quarterly earnings (loss) per share may not agree with year-to-date
earnings (loss) per share as each quarterly computation is based on the income
or loss for that quarter and the weighted average number of common shares
outstanding during that period.</p>

operations.</p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 40.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-40.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">ITEM 9.</font></b><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><i>Changes in and Disagreements with Accountants on Accounting and
Financial Disclosure.</i><a name="Item9_ChangesInAndDisagreementsWi_104936"></a></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman"><font style="font-size:10.0pt;">N</font>one.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 47.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-47.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">ITEM 9A.</font></b><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><i>Controls and Procedures.</i><a name="Item9a_ControlsAndProcedures__104957"></a></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Evaluation of
Disclosure Controls and Procedures<a name="EvaluationOfDisclosureControlsAnd_104958"></a></font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Company&#146;s management
has evaluated, as of the end of the period covered by this report, with the
supervision and participation of its Chairman, President and Chief Executive
Officer and its Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, the
effectiveness of the Company&#146;s disclosure controls and procedures as defined by
Rules&nbsp;13a-15(e)&nbsp;and 15d-15(e)&nbsp;under the Securities
Exchange Act of 1934. Based on that evaluation, such officers concluded that
the disclosure controls and procedures were effective as of the date of that
evaluation.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Management&#146;s Report
on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting<a name="ManagementsReportOnInternalContro_105002"></a></font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Company&#146;s management is responsible for
establishing and maintaining adequate internal control over financial
reporting, as such term is defined in Exchange Act Rules&nbsp;13a-15(f).
Under the supervision and with the participation of the Company&#146;s management,
including the Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer and its Senior
Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, the Company conducted an evaluation
of the effectiveness of its internal control over financial reporting based on
the framework in <i>Internal Control&#151;Integrated
Framework </i>issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the
Treadway Commission. Based on the Company&#146;s evaluation under the framework in <i>Internal Control&#151;Integrated Framework, </i>the
Company&#146;s management concluded that its internal control over financial
reporting was effective as of December&nbsp;31, 2006. The Company excluded
Latigo Petroleum,&nbsp;Inc. from its assessment of internal control over
financial reporting as of December&nbsp;31, 2006 because Latigo was acquired on
May&nbsp;2, 2006. Latigo is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company whose
total assets and total revenues represent 16% and 5%, respectively, of the
related consolidated financial statement amounts, as of and for the year ended
December&nbsp;31, 2006.</font></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">The Company&#146;s management&#146;s
assessment of the effectiveness of its internal control over financial
reporting as of December&nbsp;31, 2006 has been audited by
PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, an independent registered public accounting firm,
as stated in their report which is included herein.</font></p>

<p style="font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 10.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-10.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">Changes in Internal
Controls<a name="ChangesInInternalControls_105005"></a></font></b></p>

<p style="margin:0pt 0pt 12.0pt;text-indent:20.0pt;"><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">There were no changes in
the Company&#146;s internal control over financial reporting that occurred during
the most recent fiscal quarter that have materially affected, or are reasonably
likely to materially affect the Company&#146;s internal control over financial
reporting.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10.0pt;font-weight:bold;margin:0pt 0pt 6.0pt 47.0pt;page-break-after:avoid;text-indent:-47.0pt;"><b><font size="2" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:10.0pt;">ITEM 9B.</font></b><font size="1" face="Times New Roman" style="font-size:3.0pt;">&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160; </font><i>Other Information.</i><a name="Item9b_OtherInformation__105008"></a></p>
